text:
alice: Heads-up: scheduling deploy for model-routing-service v3 tonight. Plan: enable feature flag `session_affinity` in staged ramp (0→20% over 30m, then 20→60% over 2h) and pin model to `model-v3.2.1` during the rollout. Change window 23:00-02:00 PT. Deploy starts at 23:10 via deploy-bot. Release notes draft: short summary + link to full notes (will paste when ready).

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by alice for model-routing-service@model-v3.2.1 at 2024-11-15T23:10PT. To insert a manual holdpoint run: `/deploy holdpoint add canary-check`.

ben: can we call out rollback triggers here? want clear thresholds so oncall can act fast. @carmen any SLO cutoffs?

carmen: +1. Proposed immediate abort if: p95 latency increases >20% sustained for 10m OR error rate >0.5% for 5m. Also abort if customer-facing regressions (failed reroutes, 5xx) observed. If abort -> deploy-bot rollback to model-v3.1.8 (previous pinned). Documented in runbook.

dinesh: note: KV cache warmup for v3 can take longer. Recommend adding a 10m stabilization hold after the first 20% step before moving to 60%. Otherwise you get transient latency spikes during cache population.

eva: added the holdpoint command to the scheduled job: ``/deploy holdpoint add post-canary-stabilize 10m``. Also run this ff command during canary to pin the cohort: ``redwood ff set session_affinity --cohort=canary --percent=20 --pin-version=model-v3.2.1``. Paste this in the runbook section.

frank: I'll update the public release notes summary for the customers impacted by routing changes. Will include rollback statement and expected scaledown if we rollback.

alice: thanks all. I'll: 1) paste final release notes here by 21:00 PT, 2) add the deploy-bot holdpoint, 3) call a quick preflight at 22:50 in #eng-oncall. If anything else to add? :thumbsup:

ben: add an observability checklist please: dashboards (latency p50/p95/p99), errors by code, redis/KV hitrate, and tail-latency tracing tag `route=v3`. Also ensure alert thresholds wired to paging for oncall.

carmen: noted — added alert names to runbook: `ff-canary-p95-surge`, `ff-canary-error-rate`. Deploy-bot will post to #incidents on auto-abort.

dinesh: one more ops detail: make sure traffic-slicing key includes sticky session key header so canaries actually exercise affinity logic. Will run a small script at T-5m: ``scripts/smoke_canary.sh`` and paste results.

ale: (typo) alice: smoke script path: `infra/tools/smoke_canary.sh` — will run and attach output.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled (23:10 PT). Will post status updates in this thread during rollout. Good luck! :rocket:
